interaction_history.overview: Four friends take off on an 1800 mile road trip to retrieve an illicit tape mistakenly mailed to a girl friend.
interaction_history.title: Road Trip

interaction_history.overview: The film follows the personal relationship between a father and his two sons, one of whom is a hit-man for the Russian mafia in Brooklyn.
interaction_history.title: Little Odessa

interaction_history.overview: Conflict arises in the small town of Holly Springs when an old woman's death causes a variety of reactions among family and friends.
interaction_history.title: Cookie's Fortune

interaction_history.overview: Two gangsters seek revenge on the state jail worker who during their stay at a youth prison sexually abused them. A sensational court hearing takes place to charge him for the crimes. A moving drama from director Barry Levinson.
interaction_history.title: Sleepers

interaction_history.overview: A vampire relates his epic life story of love, betrayal, loneliness, and dark hunger to an over-curious reporter.
interaction_history.title: Interview with the Vampire

interaction_history.overview: Princess Leia is captured and held hostage by the evil Imperial forces in their effort to take over the galactic Empire. Venturesome Luke Skywalker and dashing captain Han Solo team together with the loveable robot duo R2-D2 and C-3PO to rescue the beautiful princess and restore peace and justice in the Empire.
interaction_history.title: Star Wars: Episode IV - A New Hope

interaction_history.overview: Set in the changing world of the late 1960's, Susanna Kaysen's prescribed "short rest" from a psychiatrist she had met only once becomes a strange, unknown journey into Alice's Wonderland, where she struggles with the thin line between normal and crazy. Susanna soon realizes how hard it is to get out once she has been committed, and she ultimately has to choose between the world of people who belong inside or the difficult world of reality outside.
interaction_history.title: Girl, Interrupted

interaction_history.overview: In October of 1994 three student filmmakers disappeared in the woods near Burkittsville, Maryland, while shooting a documentary. A year later their footage was found.
interaction_history.title: Blair Witch Project, The

interaction_history.overview: Renegade FBI agent Art Jeffries protects a nine-year-old autistic boy who has cracked the government's new "unbreakable" code.
interaction_history.title: Mercury Rising

interaction_history.overview: Two thieves, who travel in elegant circles, try to outsmart each other and, in the process, end up falling in love.
interaction_history.title: Entrapment
